name: jstack
description: If you want to go fast, go deep first. JStack helps you write less, but higher quality code: rigorous agent workflows you can parallelize with confidence. Codex build of the Claude Code plugin; skills are shared, tool names resolve via skills/poteto-mode/references/codex-tools.md. Built on Lauren Tan's pstack and Michael Denyer's pstack-claude port.

interface.shortDescription: Rigorous, parallelizable agent workflows: go deep first, write less, verify everything
interface.longDescription: JStack guides agent work through poteto-mode's principles, parallel design exploration (architect/arena), adversarial multi-model review (interrogate), root-cause debugging, prose deslopping, and verified delivery. Skills are shared with the Claude Code build; on Codex, tool names resolve via the codex-tools mapping.
defaultPrompt: Interrogate this diff with multiple models.
